analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($71.07) vs SMA5 ($73.21)/SMA20 ($78.40)/SMA50 ($74.47): Below short-term/mid-term trends, indicating a weak zone.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($74.31)/SMA200 ($64.70): Mixed long-term trend, above SMA200 but below SMA100.
· 52-week position (66.5%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (55.1→40.5): Entering the oversold escape zone, signaling a bearish turn.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0363→-1.5201): Continued worsening, strengthening the bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $70.52): Approaching the lower band, potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($70.96): Based on lower Bollinger Band and Pivot S1 ($63.89).
· Swing resistance ($74.18): Based on SMA50 and Pivot PP ($74.61), potential for short-term rebound if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High): Confirms continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.67x): Subdued buying interest, reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current zone diagnosis (Downtrend): Maintain wait-and-see, consider buying if resistance at $74.18 is broken.
